_comment: Append-only record of what has actually been observed for this design version (SECDA-TFLite's test_status convention).
Levels: builds_sim | cross_compiles | runs_on_hardware | verified_accurate. Outcomes: pass | fail | crash | blocked.

records.notes: SECDA-Core axi_support v6 port (SECDA-LLM ee990bb, SECDA-Core e1c1abc). Against v5 baselines taken first on the same WIP sources: test-backend-ops -b SECDA MUL_MAT 51/51 and llama-perplexity MobileLLM-125M-HF Q2_K (-c 128 --chunks 2 -b 128) 3.3449 +/- 0.59780 unchanged, and equal to the x86 CPU-only build; llama-cli greedy tokens and simulated cycle counters identical. Same for driver_batches (55/55). HWC_Reset now declared after the monitors (bea4143); simulation unchanged.
SECDA-aarch64-kria preset (BUILD_KRIA, ACC_PRELOAD, secda_corev6); driver and driver_batches both compile.

First hardware build through the SECDA-Core flow: BFPP_ACC_KRIA_3_0, KRIA_dma_4_hp_4_ctrl_hwc.tcl, 200 MHz (FCLK 199.998), timing-tolerated, WNS -0.307 ns (6.1%), WHS/WPWS >= 0, IO and utilization gates pass, .hwh addresses match acc_config.sc.h. kriaB_L (kernel 1027+secda1), PYNQ load as root, test_0928b checksummed. test-backend-ops -b SECDA MUL_MAT 51/51 vs CPU; llama-perplexity 3.3625 +/- 0.60376, identical to the board's CPU-only build (x86 gives 3.3449: CPU-op rounding differs between ARM and x86, not the accelerator); llama-cli greedy tokens as in simulation; 30/30 MUL_MAT nodes preloaded. No cma_alloc failure, no u-dma-buf left, board reset to CPU_1_0.

Minimal llama.cpp fork (625ec1d28: backend registration only) with the backend planning from graph_optimize (875e34b) and the secda-* tools (srcs/tools). Same BFPP_ACC_KRIA_3_0 bitstream. kriaB_L test_0928c, driver and driver_batches: secda-test-backend-ops MUL_MAT 51/51 (driver_batches 55/55); llama-perplexity 3.3625 +/- 0.60376 (= board CPU-only build); secda-llama-cli 30/30 nodes preloaded in every plan, no SECDA WARNING, generated text identical to simulation; secda-llama-bench and secda-llama-cli write llama_perf.csv, synth vtbo/tbo written. No cma_alloc failure, no u-dma-buf left. Simulation: 68/68 gate checks identical to the pre-change baseline.

secda_profile.json: secda-llama-cli on kriaB_L (after a reboot: CMA had fragmented after 38 h up and the 4x192 MB u-dma-bufs failed) writes it next to prf.csv; timings equal prf.csv; 13 named counters with real totals (Load_Unit 9.6e6 cycles x 5 ns = fpga_weight_transfer_cycles). Simulation gate 68/68 unchanged.

KV260 kriaB_L, test_0928e (checksummed), bitstream unchanged (same sha256 as the 2026-09-28 records). Binaries built from ce9d85c plus the TODO 1.3 change committed with this record (secda-test-backend-ops: a NaN output now fails the case, as upstream). Perplexity input perplexity/ppl_input.txt (md5 b6d844ba5fc667529f6efd3cf3cdd204), MobileLLM-125M-HF Q2_K, -c 128 --chunks 2 -t 1. driver and driver_batches: MUL_MAT 51/51 and 55/55, no 'NaN at index' lines. -b 128: 3.3625 +/- 0.60376 (1 of 30 MUL_MATs per chunk on SECDA, as before). -b 16 -ub 16: all 30 MUL_MATs on SECDA and preloaded, no SECDA WARNING, 3.3636 +/- 0.60469 (chunks [1]3.3273 [2]3.3636), identical across both drivers and both designs. References at -b 16 -ub 16: board CPU-only 3.3596 ([1]3.3414); x86 CPU-only 3.3637 ([1]3.3601); x86 SystemC simulation 3.3429 ([1]3.3146). The board's accelerator is within 0.12% of the board CPU, but simulation sits 0.6% below x86 CPU, so simulation and board are not numerically equivalent at -b 16; cause not yet found (TODO 1.5). No u-dma-buf left, no CMA allocation errors.

Gate suite (68 checks, all 4 sim variants) identical to the minimal-fork baseline with the TODO 1.3 patch (NaN fails a case): no 'NaN at index' line in any log. Perplexity at -b 16 -ub 16 on perplexity/ppl_input.txt: 3.3429 +/- 0.59671 ([1]3.3146), 30/30 MUL_MATs on SECDA; x86 CPU-only gives 3.3637. llama-cli -fa off: v3 text identical to the CPU-only build.

Simulation vs hardware, bit for bit (TODO 1.5, scripts/sim_replay): 60 MUL_MAT calls (ffn_down q3_K, M=576 K=1536, N=1/2/16) captured on kriaB_L (BFPP_ACC_KRIA_3_0, driver) during the -b 16 -ub 16 perplexity run and replayed through the SystemC model: 0 of 310,464 outputs differ. Replaying a simulation capture in simulation also gives 0. This corrects the previous record: the -b 16 perplexity gap (sim 3.3429 vs board 3.3636) is not the accelerator. The q8_K activations differ between ARM and x86 from call 0 (CPU-op rounding upstream of each MUL_MAT; weights identical).

Explicit MUL_MAT layers (TODO 2.1/2.2, driver and driver_batches), with the change committed alongside this record. Gate suite (68 checks, all 4 sim variants) identical to the minimal-fork baseline. llama-cli -fa off: text identical to the x86 CPU-only build.

Explicit MUL_MAT layers on kriaB_L (test_0928f, checksummed; bitstream unchanged). driver and driver_batches: MUL_MAT 51/51 and 55/55; -b 16 -ub 16 perplexity 3.3636 +/- 0.60469 (30/30 preloaded), unchanged; secda-llama-cli text with flash attention auto and -fa off identical to the board CPU-only build's -fa off text and to the x86 CPU; no SECDA WARNING, no NaN, no u-dma-buf left.

sched-sync applied (19 DWAIT sites, acc_schedule.h; converged on pass 2, SECDA-Core 48da6eb), monitor targets 5-7=1 and 12=2, fpga_compute_cycles from HWC_X1_Compute; committed alongside this record. Gate suite vs its previous baseline: only fpga_compute_cycles / fpga_weight_transfer_cycles differ (16 of 68 checks); pass counts, perplexity, text and warnings identical; re-baselined. test-backend-ops MUL_MAT 51/51.

kriaB_L after a reboot (test_0928g, checksummed; bitstream unchanged). driver and driver_batches: MUL_MAT 51/51 and 55/55; secda-llama-cli text (flash attention auto and -fa off) equal to the board CPU's -fa off text; no warnings, no u-dma-buf left. llama-cli -n 4 counters, board vs synced sim: HWC_X1_Compute 80,342,232 vs 61,212,672 (1.31; 21x before sched-sync), Load_Unit 5.35M vs 3.63M (1.47); fpga_compute_cycles 401,711 us = 98% of the wall-clock fpga_compute 409,749 us. The first attempt (2026-09-28) hit cma_alloc failures and the board went down; not counted.
